music.modifications: Generated with Google Lyria 3 Pro (lyria-3-pro-preview) from an original timeline prompt (tools/production/github-remotion-20261013/s123-ink-press/music-prompt.txt, take score-s123a); re-timed by music_build.py (groove enters on the first deck shot, breath before the finale, the track's own ending placed after the wordmark stamp) plus NumPy-synthesized sound design pinned to the same frames as the upstream template's SFX table (whooshes, typing, pops, riser, impact, sparkle); no third-party recordings or samples; encoded to 40 kbps MP3, 48 kHz stereo. Timed to sample S123; other films will not hit its accents.
